title: License Renewal for Student Services Personnel
source_file: View Policy LICN-032_ License Renewal for Student Services Personnel _ NC State Board of Education.html

blocks.text: This Policy establishes the requirements for student services personnel to renew a continuing professional license.
Each person holding a student services personnel license must renew that license every five years.
Student services personnel must complete eight CEUs during each renewal cycle consisting of the following:
Four CEUs that align with the North Carolina standards for the relevant professional discipline, as outlined in the State Board of Education Policy Series on Qualifications and Evaluation (EVAL).
blocks.label: (a)

blocks.text: Four general CEUs that are germane to the K-12 educational environment.
blocks.label: (b)

blocks.text: A person serving as a school audiologist or school speech-language pathologist shall be exempt from the continuing education requirements of this Policy so long as the person continues to satisfy the applicable requirements of LICN-012.
